title: Natural strokes
text: Smoothed curves whose width follows pen pressure or drawing speed, sharp on high-DPI screens.

title: Typed alternative
text: A Type mode for keyboard and screen-reader users renders the name as the signature.

title: Undo and clear
text: Remove the last stroke or start over, with spoken confirmation.

title: PNG and SVG
text: Export data URLs or submit them with a native form.

title: Resize safe
text: Points are stored relative to the pad, so the signature rescales with the layout.
